research_notes: Initial research: official current/historical biographies, 2004 and 2016 speeches, party biography, ABC candidate history, contemporary ASU bulletin lodged in court, club annual report reproduction and parliamentary fee discussion.

Remaining gaps: paid paper-selling employer and dates; factory name; taxi operator and work arrangement; insurer/control history; individual hours/leave; exact political-office transitions; ASU start; Statewide trustee reports and all governance remuneration/endpoints.

Targeted searches for underwriter employer, full-time work, Statewide 2014/2015 annual reports and football board reports yielded no usable named insurance employer or substantive full-time proof. 2012 club report distinguishes honorary title from employee list; unrelated full-time references were excluded.
Statewide fee allegation is retained as a research lead requiring primary audited report, not used as evidence that the member received or retained an amount. No headline derived from directors fees.
Parliamentary defeat in 2013 and return in 2016 leave a real employment interval; union organising and governance during that interval are not relabelled public/private full-time employment.

Follow-up2026-10-02: primary union report resolves Statewide trustee and confirms branch receipt of fees, while exposing2013versusJuly2014start conflict. Adds previously unrecorded Electricity Industry Superannuation Scheme board endingAugust2014 with no board fees. No aggregate employee/FTE count assigned personally.

Club primary indexed history establishes Adelaide Hellenic Lions presidency1991–1992. Glendi board remains unverified lead. Factory, taxi and insurer employers/hours remain unknown after targeted searches; current Guardian Insurance event attendance is not employment evidence.

Follow-up2026-10-03: prior-year ASU operating report narrows EISS trustee-board service toFebruary–August2014 and independently confirms Statewide service fromJuly2014. It also calls Georganas a branch employee, consistent with the existing2013–2016ASU spell but not proof of full-time hours. Targeted insurer, taxi, factory, Thebarton and Statewide searches did not resolve the remaining employer or substantive-hours gaps.
